system.description:
The sheer force of your personality makes the stalwart tremble. Heads bow, hearts break, and none dare challenge you or risk your ire.

Expend a Willpower Trait to exert Majesty for a scene or a full hour (represent it with arms held out, or a card or ribbon). While it lasts, no one within 10 feet who can see you may insult or attack you. To break through, a subject must make a Social Challenge against you and spend a Willpower Trait to make the attempt; failure means they cannot challenge your Majesty again that scene. A Willpower Trait may be spent for a retest when penetrating Majesty - an exception to the usual rule. If you attack or take a hostile action the aura fades at once, though you may still use non-harmful Social and Mental Disciplines such as Entrancement or Dominate.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
